# SheetJS CE

`xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the unmodified SheetJS CE 0.20.3 npm distribution.

- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz
- Installation documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/nodejs/
- License: Apache-2.0; the license is included in the archive.

The dependency is vendored so local and CI builds use the same official release.
